essence: Turbulent Displace generates a procedural turbulence field, then uses that field to remap where source pixels are sampled, bending the image without adding new imagery. Amount sets the displacement distance; Size sets the field's spatial scale, while Complexity adds smaller nested variation. Offset and Evolution move or evolve the field itself, making an otherwise static warp read as flowing, boiling, or unstable.
when_to_use: wavy text / 文字波浪变形
animated glitch-free warp / 动态扰动变形
manifests_as: The layer appears pushed and pulled by soft-to-sharp procedural waves, with contours wobbling, swelling, twisting, or rippling according to the selected displacement mode.

key_levers.name: Displacement
key_levers.effect: Selects the procedural displacement mode, changing the directional character of the warp (for example, broadly turbulent versus more directional or shape-like behavior); exact numeric label mapping must be verified.

key_levers.name: Amount
key_levers.effect: Sets how far pixels are displaced by the turbulence field; larger absolute values make the warp stronger, while negative values reverse the field's displacement direction.

key_levers.name: Size
key_levers.effect: Sets the size of the turbulence structures: lower values create dense, small ripples; higher values create broad, slow undulations.

key_levers.name: Offset (Turbulence)
key_levers.effect: Translates the procedural field across the layer without moving the layer itself; animating it makes the distortion travel in a chosen screen direction.

key_levers.name: Complexity
key_levers.effect: Adds nested detail to the turbulence field; increasing it makes a simple broad warp break into more irregular, multi-scale distortion.

key_levers.name: Evolution
key_levers.effect: Changes the generated turbulence pattern over time; animating it produces internal boiling or morphing rather than a field merely sliding across the image.

key_levers.name: Random Seed
key_levers.effect: Chooses a different deterministic turbulence pattern while preserving the current Amount, Size, and Complexity character.

key_levers.name: Effect Opacity
key_levers.effect: Blends the processed distortion with the original layer; reduce it when the warp shape is right but its visible intensity is too aggressive.

config_recipes.subtle heat shimmer: Displacement=1, Amount=12, Size=180, Complexity=2, Evolution animated from 0 to 120 degrees over 2 seconds, Effect Opacity=70.
config_recipes.broad liquid wobble: Displacement=1, Amount=55, Size=260, Complexity=2, Offset (Turbulence) animated 320,180 to 520,180 over 3 seconds, Effect Opacity=100.
config_recipes.violent boiling distortion: Displacement=1, Amount=140, Size=55, Complexity=7, Evolution animated from 0 to 720 degrees over 2 seconds, Random Seed=24.
config_recipes.fine nervous edge flutter: Displacement=1, Amount=18, Size=28, Complexity=4, Evolution animated from 0 to 180 degrees over 1 second, Effect Opacity=85.

reasoning_hooks: Amount at 0 produces no visible displacement regardless of Size, Complexity, Evolution, or the selected mode.
Size controls feature scale, not strength: increase Amount for a stronger warp; decrease Size for more numerous, tighter waves.
A static turbulence field can look like a one-time warped still. Animate Offset for directional drift, or Evolution for pattern morphing/boiling; they produce different motion reads.
Complexity is most useful after Size and Amount establish the main shape. Raising Complexity first can add busy detail without solving an overly weak or overly large-scale warp.
Large Amount values can push source sampling beyond the layer bounds; inspect edges and verify Pinning or Resize Layer behavior when edge clipping matters.
Cycle Evolution only matters when enabled; use it when a seamless repeating Evolution loop is required, and verify the cycle-length behavior in the UI.
